name: Amari Himari
source:
[b]A Gyaru who seems cheerful and outgoing, but is actually shy and easily flustered[/b]

A girl who belongs to the fashion design club.
She appears to be a bright and sociable gyaru-type girl, but in reality, she struggles with stage fright and was originally more of an introverted "gloomy" type. Her club is currently facing the threat of being disbanded, and to meet the school’s conditions for keeping it alive, she's working on creating an outfit to enter in a design contest.

She’s friends with Tsukune and had heard about Hatsune before, which sparked her curiosity. However, when they finally met, she was shocked to learn that Hatsune was actually a guy—she had been told he was Tsukune's "sister".

She’s also friends with Aoi, and they used to enjoy cosplaying together from time to time. Lately, though, they’ve grown distant, and she feels a bit lonely because of it.


•Her birthday it's the same day as the "Love day"
•She is good at: Gaming (on mobile), design, sports.
•She is bad at: Talking to people she meets for the first time.

[i]"I heard it was your older sister, but it’s actually your older brother………!!"[/i]
